jobs.J1: You want to figure out whether adding a free tier would grow your product. Ask Preveti that question and answer its follow-up questions until the question is framed and you can see what Preveti will investigate next.
jobs.J10: Find out which plan you are on, how many credits you have left, and what you need to do this month to keep your Design Partner pricing.
jobs.J3: Take the 'Raise Pro to $149' bet forward: give it a stakes estimate, then review and approve it so it is committed with your reasoning recorded.
jobs.J7: Pressure-test the 'Raise Pro to $149' bet by simulating how your customers would respond, and read the verdict on whether to go ahead.
jobs.J8b: You were sent this link to give feedback on a product's pricing. Agree to take part and answer the first question.
jobs.admin: Review the pending Startup plan application and approve it if the company meets the criteria.
jobs.proposal: An assistant suggested a change to your 'Should we raise Pro to $149?' analysis. Find the suggestion, review it, and accept it if it is reasonable.
jobs.J2: Customers keep cancelling after their first month and you don't know why. Talk it through with Preveti until you have a concrete bet saved that you could go on to test.
jobs.J8a: Set up a customer interview about the 'Raise Pro to $149' bet so you can send a customer a link, and check whether anyone has responded yet.
